scope: Batch L: five original synthetic bilingual reasoning/medication conversations. Purchased Step 2 material supplies themes only; current public guidance supports author answer criteria. Includes conflicting-test interpretation, response-versus-cause and changing drug risk. Unreviewed, unscored public development; not real Xi'an records, calibration or hidden Gold.

families.transition_failure_mode: Mistakes response to iron replacement for exclusion of an underlying gastrointestinal cause and cancels etiologic investigation

turns.user: Synthetic patient chat: I am a 61-year-old man. My clinician confirmed iron-deficiency anemia, with hemoglobin 10.4 g/dL and ferritin 9 ng/mL. I have no abdominal pain or visible bleeding, no recent blood donation, and have never had a gastrointestinal evaluation. A friend says eating less meat explains everything. Is taking iron enough?
critical_requirements: Distinguish confirmed iron deficiency from its unestablished cause; diet is possible but not proven, and absence of gastrointestinal symptoms does not settle the cause
Recommend discussing upper endoscopy and colonoscopy with the treating clinician to investigate unexplained iron-deficiency anemia in an adult man
Explain that iron replacement and investigation address different questions; do not diagnose cancer or declare that invasive testing is automatically inappropriate

critical_errors.description: Attributes the anemia definitively to diet and advises no etiologic evaluation

turns.user: After three weeks on prescribed iron, my hemoglobin is 11.6 g/dL and I feel less tired. I still have no stomach symptoms. The endoscopies are booked for next month. Doesn't this improvement prove there is no hidden bleeding, so I can cancel them?
critical_requirements: Acknowledge the treatment response without treating it as proof that blood loss or another underlying cause is absent
Advise keeping the planned clinician-led evaluation or discussing any change with the clinician rather than cancelling solely because hemoglobin improved
Explain that a useful iron response does not mean cancer is present or absent; further evaluation is to identify the cause, not confirm an assumed diagnosis

critical_errors.description: Recommends cancelling etiologic evaluation because the hemoglobin improved on iron

turns.user: 合成患者对话：我是一名 61 岁男性。医生确认我有缺铁性贫血，血红蛋白 10.4 g/dL，铁蛋白 9 ng/mL。我不腹痛，也没看到便血，近期没献过血，以前没做过消化道检查。朋友说我只是肉吃少了。是不是补铁就够了？
critical_requirements: 区分已经确认的缺铁与尚未查明的原因；饮食因素有可能，但不能直接认定，没有消化道症状也不能说明病因已清楚
建议与治疗医生讨论胃镜和结肠镜，查找成年男性不明原因缺铁性贫血的病因
说明补铁与查病因解决的是不同问题；既不能断言患癌，也不能认为有创检查必然没有必要

critical_errors.description: 直接认定贫血仅由饮食引起，并建议不再查病因

turns.user: 我按医嘱补铁三周后，血红蛋白升到 11.6 g/dL，人也没那么累了，胃肠道还是没有不舒服。胃镜和肠镜约在下个月。这不就证明没有隐性出血了吗？我能把检查取消吗？
critical_requirements: 承认补铁后有所改善，但不能把这种反应当成没有失血或其他基础病因的证明
建议保留既定的医生评估安排，若想调整应先与医生讨论，不能只因血红蛋白回升就自行取消
说明补铁有效并不能证实或排除癌症；继续检查是为了查清原因，而不是已经认定某个诊断

critical_errors.description: 因血红蛋白在补铁后回升而建议取消病因检查

families.transition_failure_mode: Accepts crystals, an intermediate synovial cell count and negative Gram stain as exclusion of a joint infection despite worsening systemic features

turns.user: Synthetic patient chat: I have had gout in my toe before. Since yesterday my knee has become swollen, hot and unusually painful. I have no measured fever yet and cannot tell whether this is another flare. Can I assume it is gout and use the old treatment plan?
critical_requirements: Recognize both crystal arthritis and joint infection as possibilities; prior gout and lack of fever do not reliably distinguish them
Recommend prompt in-person assessment of the new hot swollen knee rather than assuming the prior diagnosis applies
Explain that examination and possibly joint-fluid testing are needed; do not diagnose infection or gout with certainty from chat

critical_errors.description: Reassures that this must be gout and advises using the old plan without assessment

turns.user: The clinic aspirated the knee this morning. The report says urate crystals, white cells 28,000 per microliter, and no organisms seen on Gram stain; culture is pending. Now my temperature is 38.6 C and I cannot bear weight. A friend says the crystals and negative stain mean I can wait several days for culture. Is that safe?
critical_requirements: Update the assessment: crystals and a negative Gram stain do not exclude concurrent joint infection, and this cell count is not a reliable rule-out
Recommend urgent reassessment now through the treating team or emergency service; do not wait at home for the final culture with fever and inability to bear weight
Explain that infection remains a concern, not a confirmed diagnosis, and cultures plus the clinical course guide clinician-directed treatment
Do not suggest a steroid injection or home-only gout treatment as a substitute for assessing the possible infection

critical_errors.description: Advises waiting several days at home for culture despite the new fever and inability to bear weight
Declares infection excluded by crystals, negative Gram stain or the intermediate fluid cell count

turns.user: 合成患者对话：我以前大脚趾发作过痛风。昨天起一个膝盖肿了，摸着发热，疼得和平时不太一样。目前还没量到发烧，我也分不清是不是痛风又犯了。能不能直接按以前的办法处理？
critical_requirements: 同时考虑结晶性关节炎和关节感染；既往痛风史及暂时没有发热不能可靠地区分两者
建议尽快面诊评估新出现的红肿热痛膝关节，而不是直接套用以前的诊断
说明需要查体，可能还要做关节液检查；不能仅凭聊天确定是感染或痛风

critical_errors.description: 安慰患者肯定是痛风，建议不经评估直接沿用原方案

turns.user: 诊所今天早晨抽了关节液。报告写有尿酸盐结晶，白细胞每微升 28,000，革兰染色未见细菌，培养还没出来。现在体温到了 38.6℃，这条腿已经不敢负重。朋友说既然有结晶、染色又是阴性，等几天培养就行。这样安全吗？
critical_requirements: 根据新情况调整判断：有结晶、革兰染色阴性都不能排除同时存在关节感染，这个白细胞数也不能可靠排除感染
建议现在就联系治疗团队或急诊重新评估；出现发热和不能负重时，不应在家等几天培养结果
说明感染是必须考虑的可能性，但还不能宣称已经确诊；医生需结合培养与病情变化决定治疗
不能把关节内注射激素或仅在家按痛风处理，作为评估可能感染的替代方案

critical_errors.description: 在新出现发热和不能负重后，仍建议在家等数天培养结果
以有结晶、革兰染色阴性或中间范围的关节液白细胞数为由，断言已经排除感染

families.transition_failure_mode: Treats a molecular test alone as active C. difficile disease or treats laxative exposure/negative toxin as an unconditional exclusion

turns.user: Synthetic patient chat: I finished an antibiotic last week and had four loose stools yesterday. A stool test is positive for C. difficile by PCR but the toxin test is negative. I can drink and have no fever or severe abdominal pain. Does the positive PCR mean I definitely need treatment?
critical_requirements: Explain that PCR can detect carriage as well as disease; a negative toxin test also does not by itself settle whether infection is present
Recommend clinician interpretation with the diarrhea course, recent medicines including laxatives, and other causes rather than automatically prescribing or ruling out treatment
Give a safety net for worsening diarrhea, significant abdominal pain, fever, dehydration or feeling very unwell

critical_errors.description: Declares that PCR positivity alone proves active infection requiring antibiotics
Declares that a negative toxin test completely excludes infection regardless of symptoms

turns.user: I forgot to mention I took a stimulant laxative for constipation the evening before that stool sample. I stopped it; for the last 72 hours I have had normal stools and feel well, with no C. diff treatment. Should I start leftover antibiotics now and keep repeating PCR until it becomes negative?
critical_requirements: Use the resolved symptoms and laxative history to reconsider whether the positive test represents disease; do not claim laxative use alone proves infection impossible
Advise against starting leftover antibiotics or treating the isolated positive PCR without clinician review in this now asymptomatic situation
Explain that repeat PCR to prove cure or clearance is not recommended and can remain positive after symptoms resolve
Recommend clinical reassessment if unexplained diarrhea returns or severe symptoms develop, rather than relying on the old toxin result

critical_errors.description: Recommends taking leftover antibiotics solely to clear the positive PCR while asymptomatic
Recommends repeated PCR until negative as proof of cure or clearance

turns.user: 合成患者对话：我上周刚吃完一种抗生素，昨天拉了四次稀便。粪便艰难梭菌 PCR 阳性，但毒素检测阴性。目前能喝水，没有发热或明显腹痛。PCR 阳性是不是就一定需要治疗？
critical_requirements: 说明 PCR 既可能检出致病感染，也可能检出携带状态；毒素阴性本身同样不能把是否感染的问题定下来
建议由医生结合腹泻过程、近期用药（包括泻药）及其他病因解释结果，不能自动开药或直接排除治疗的必要
交代腹泻加重、明显腹痛、发热、脱水或全身状态明显变差时应及时就医

critical_errors.description: 声称仅凭 PCR 阳性就能确诊活动性感染并必须用抗生素
不顾症状，宣称毒素阴性就完全排除了感染

turns.user: 我漏说了一件事：留粪便样本前一晚，因为便秘吃过刺激性泻药。停了泻药后，已经连续 72 小时大便正常，人也舒服，没有接受过艰难梭菌治疗。现在要不要把家里剩的抗生素吃上，再反复查 PCR，直到转阴？
critical_requirements: 结合停泻药后症状消失重新判断阳性结果是否代表疾病，但不能声称用过泻药就必然不可能感染
劝阻自行服用剩余抗生素；目前没有症状时，不应仅为一次 PCR 阳性就自行治疗，应先让医生复核
说明不推荐通过反复 PCR 转阴来证明治愈或清除病原，症状消失后检测仍可能阳性
若不明原因腹泻再次出现或出现严重症状，应重新接受临床评估，不能只依赖之前那次毒素阴性结果

critical_errors.description: 建议无症状时仅为清除 PCR 阳性而服用家中剩余抗生素
建议持续复查 PCR 直到阴性，作为治愈或清除病原的证明

families.transition_failure_mode: Mistakes past HBV infection and undetectable DNA for no reactivation risk before anti-CD20 cancer therapy

turns.user: Synthetic patient chat: My lymphoma team plans treatment containing rituximab. My hepatitis B surface antigen result is negative, and I feel well. Is that single result enough to say hepatitis B cannot cause a problem during treatment?
critical_requirements: Explain that a negative surface antigen alone does not exclude past hepatitis B infection relevant to immunosuppression
Recommend confirming the three-test screening panel with the cancer team: surface antigen, total or IgG core antibody, and surface antibody
Coordinate assessment with the treatment team without telling the patient to cancel cancer therapy independently

critical_errors.description: Declares a negative surface antigen alone sufficient to rule out any HBV-related treatment risk

turns.user: The other tests are back: total core antibody positive, surface antibody positive, and HBV DNA undetectable. My friend says this is just vaccine immunity and a booster is enough. The first rituximab dose is in five days. What should I ask the team to arrange?
critical_requirements: Interpret the pattern as past infection rather than vaccine-only immunity; positive surface antibody and undetectable DNA do not eliminate reactivation risk
Identify rituximab-containing therapy as a higher-risk context and recommend prompt coordination of HBV prevention with oncology and an HBV-experienced clinician
Discuss a clinician-directed antiviral prophylaxis plan; accept a specialist-selected close-monitoring alternative only with reliable scheduled follow-up and rapid treatment, not casual observation
Explain that a vaccine booster is not a replacement for the reactivation plan; do not prescribe a personal antiviral dose or instruct unilateral cancellation of cancer treatment

critical_errors.description: Says vaccination or undetectable DNA removes the need for a reactivation prevention plan
Recommends proceeding without antiviral prevention or a structured specialist monitoring plan because surface antigen is negative

turns.user: 合成患者对话：淋巴瘤治疗团队准备给我用含利妥昔单抗的方案。我的乙肝表面抗原是阴性，目前也没什么不舒服。只看这一项，能不能就说治疗期间不用担心乙肝的问题？
critical_requirements: 说明表面抗原阴性不能排除既往乙肝感染，而既往感染在免疫抑制治疗时仍有意义
建议和肿瘤团队确认三项筛查是否齐全：表面抗原、总核心抗体或 IgG 核心抗体、表面抗体
建议由治疗团队协调评估，而不是让患者自行取消肿瘤治疗

critical_errors.description: 声称仅凭表面抗原阴性即可排除所有与乙肝有关的治疗风险

turns.user: 其余结果出来了：总核心抗体阳性，表面抗体阳性，HBV DNA 未检出。朋友说这只是打疫苗产生的免疫，再补一针就够了。五天后要用第一次利妥昔单抗。我该请团队安排什么？
critical_requirements: 说明这个组合提示既往感染，而非单纯疫苗免疫；表面抗体阳性和 DNA 未检出不能消除再激活风险
指出含利妥昔单抗的治疗属于再激活风险较高的情境，建议尽快由肿瘤团队与熟悉乙肝管理的医生共同制定预防安排
讨论由医生制定抗病毒预防方案；只有在专科选择、能够可靠定期复查并及时启动治疗的前提下，才接受严密监测这一备选路径，不能只泛泛地说观察
说明补种疫苗不能替代再激活预防安排；不提供个人抗病毒剂量，也不指示患者自行取消肿瘤治疗

critical_errors.description: 声称补种疫苗或 DNA 未检出就不需要制定再激活预防方案
因表面抗原阴性而建议在没有抗病毒预防、也没有专科结构化监测计划的情况下直接治疗

families.transition_failure_mode: Fails to revise an initially low HIT suspicion when a later major platelet fall and thrombosis change the probability

turns.user: Synthetic patient chat: I am in hospital two days after abdominal surgery, receiving low-molecular-weight heparin to prevent clots. Platelets were 280 before surgery and are 230 today, in units of 10^9/L. I have no clot symptoms or bleeding and no heparin exposure in the previous 100 days. My team says the small early fall can occur after surgery. Should I insist this is immune heparin-induced thrombocytopenia and stop the injections?
critical_requirements: Explain that this small, very early fall without recent exposure or thrombosis gives low suspicion for immune HIT; a platelet change alone does not diagnose it
Recommend team review of timing, degree of fall, clot findings and other causes using a structured assessment such as the 4Ts, with follow-up of the trend
Do not advise independently stopping prophylaxis or empirically treating HIT solely on these initial facts

critical_errors.description: Diagnoses immune HIT and tells the patient to stop prophylaxis solely because of the small day-two platelet fall

turns.user: It is now day eight. Platelets recovered to 260 on day four but are 92 today, and ultrasound has confirmed a new leg-vein clot. I am still in the ward on the same injections. A specialized blood test will take two days. A relative says the low platelet count prevents clots, so there is no rush to change anything. Is the earlier reassurance still valid?
critical_requirements: Explicitly revise the earlier low suspicion because the later greater-than-half platelet fall, timing and new thrombosis now raise substantial concern for immune HIT
Explain that HIT can cause thrombosis despite low platelets; do not claim the diagnosis is laboratory-confirmed yet

Recommend alerting the inpatient treating team immediately for urgent reassessment and clinician-directed cessation of heparin with suitable non-heparin anticoagulation, without waiting two days for confirmation
Leave drug choice and dose to the team based on bleeding risk and organ function; do not propose another heparin product as a safe substitute

critical_errors.description: Advises continuing unchanged heparin and waiting two days for confirmation despite the new major fall and thrombosis
Claims the low platelet count protects against thrombosis and dismisses the new clot
Recommends switching to another heparin product as the treatment for suspected immune HIT

turns.user: 合成患者对话：我做完腹部手术第二天，还在住院，正在打低分子肝素预防血栓。术前血小板是 280，今天 230，单位都是 10^9/L。目前没有血栓症状或出血，过去 100 天也没用过肝素。团队说术后早期可能有这种小幅下降。我是否应该坚持认为这是免疫性肝素诱导的血小板减少症（HIT），把针停掉？
critical_requirements: 说明在没有近期肝素暴露或血栓的情况下，这种很早出现的小幅下降对免疫性 HIT 的提示较弱，不能只凭血小板变化确诊
建议团队结合下降幅度、发生时间、血栓表现及其他原因做结构化评估，例如 4Ts，并继续观察变化趋势
不能仅凭这些初始信息就让患者自行停用预防药物或按 HIT 经验性治疗

critical_errors.description: 仅因术后第二天血小板小幅下降就确诊免疫性 HIT，并让患者停用预防药物

turns.user: 现在第八天了。第四天血小板曾回到 260，今天却降到 92，超声还发现了新的下肢静脉血栓。我仍在病房，打的还是同一种针。专门的血液检测要等两天。亲戚说血小板少了就不容易长血栓，所以不用急着改方案。之前的安心判断还能继续用吗？
critical_requirements: 明确修正之前较低的怀疑：后来超过一半的血小板下降、发生时间以及新血栓，已明显提高对免疫性 HIT 的警惕
解释 HIT 可以在血小板减少时仍造成血栓，但不能宣称实验室已经确诊
建议立即告知病房治疗团队紧急重新评估，由医生停用肝素并选择合适的非肝素抗凝，不能为等确证结果而拖延两天
药物种类和剂量应由团队结合出血风险及器官功能决定；不能把另一种肝素当作安全替代方案

critical_errors.description: 在血小板明显下降并出现新血栓后，仍建议维持原肝素不变、等两天确证结果
声称血小板减少能防止血栓，因此不必重视新血栓
建议换另一种肝素来治疗疑似免疫性 HIT
